question: Which of the following is an example of an open-source desktop Operating System?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Linux Ubuntu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Linux Ubuntu** is an **open-source desktop operating system** based on the Linux kernel.
 
• It is developed and maintained by **Canonical Ltd.**, a company founded in **2004**.
 
• The operating system is freely available for everyone and can be modified and redistributed due to its **open-source nature.**
 
• Ubuntu offers a wide range of **customization options** and supports a vast number of **software packages**, making it suitable for both personal and professional use.
